title: Architecte mo njiɗngu fenaande
intro: Limre laamu mawnde meeɗiino golloraade gooto e laamɓe ɓurɓe lollude e daartol e nder Misra ɓooyɗo. Oo neɗɗo halfinaama yamiroore cuusal — mahde mbaydi ndi njiɗ-ɗaa haɓaade kammu. Daartol maɓɓe ina darii e Qur’aana ko jannde teskinnde no ɗooftaare wumre e mawnikinaare addanta tan bonnude.
clues: Mi golliima e nder ñaawirɗe laamɗo baawɗo wiyde ina jogii laamɗo dow leyɗeele ɗee.
Miɗo joginoo darnde jaagorde toownde, miɗo wasiyoo tippudi ɓurndi mawnikinaare e jamaanu am.
Laamcfo am oo, 6uuccii Alla Muusaa, mo 6e cali ja6de.
Mi yamiraama yo mi mah suudu toowndu nduu, mbele laamɗo am ina waawa ƴeeŋtude haa asamaan.
Tower oo meeɗaa yettaade asamaan, maccungaagu am e mawnikinaare addani mi hersa haa abada.
Mi halkii e mo njokkondir-mi oo, innde am wonti jeertinaango duumotoongo e baawɓe tiiɗde.

trial.answer: Yamiraama mahde mbaydi toowndi ngam yettaade asamaan

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verse: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority (40:23)
